title: EgressAllowedEvent
description: The egress proxy let the run's sandbox reach a destination (OB-03): every egress decision is an audit record, a refusal as `gateway.refused`, an allowance as this. The proxy reports it with the run's own gateway token; Node writes it on the run's stream once per run, host and route, and at most a fixed number per run. A bare host name and how it was reached only: never a URL path, query or content, but for an allowed website (WP-63), whose `site` names the path the run's activity shows, once per path and use. Folds ignore it; it is an audit record.

host.description: The destination host; never a path or query.

via.description: http: forwarded in the clear (the gateways included); intercepted: inside a TLS connection the proxy ended; tunnel: an opaque CONNECT tunnel; database: a PostgreSQL connection the proxy signed in.

attemptId.description: The attempt the reporting token was issued for, from the verified token.

SiteReport.description: WP-63: what the run's sandbox did at an allowed website an admin named, as the run's activity shows it. The one place an egress record holds a path: no query or fragment, tokens masked, at most 121 characters.

access.description: How the site is allowed: read, read-write, or host-level only (an uninspected tunnel).

use.description: read: GET, HEAD or OPTIONS; write: anything else (a POST, a PUT).
